name: Eggs Finance
description: Eggs Finance is a DeFi application aimed at helping Sonic token ($S) holders enhance their returns through a unique up-only token mechanism. The protocol leverages the $EGGS token' distinctive features, including burning mechanisms and specific fee models, to ensure that the backing ratio of $S per $EGGS consistently increases. This design guarantees that the value of $EGGS, when measured in $S, can only rise over time. Users are encouraged to consult the provided documentation for guidance on effectively utilizing the Eggs Finance protocol.
